verdict.rationale: The axis applies because a public government web service can publish a robots.txt. The only recorded probe returned HTTP 403 at https://www.mca.gov.in/robots.txt, and the NSWS layer above the registry was blocked the same way. An agent therefore cannot read any crawl policy before fetching, and nothing in the evidence shows a readable robots.txt exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
